name: Omapass
author: Elvis Gastelum
description: Proton Pass picker for the Omarchy bar: search, copy and manage entries from the keyboard

schema.label: Clipboard clear (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds before a copied secret is cleared from the clipboard. 0 keeps it until replaced.

schema.label: Paste once
schema.description: Clear the clipboard after the first paste instead of waiting for the timer.

schema.label: Hidden vaults
schema.description: JSON array of vault share_ids to hide

schema.label: Show recents
schema.description: List recently used entries at the top of the picker.

schema.label: Web account number
schema.description: Proton web session number used in /u/<n>/ links

schema.label: Refresh max age (seconds)
schema.description: Reuse cached entries younger than this many seconds before fetching again.
